Noah: Hi all, second day here. Trying to finish the Mac M2 bootstrap. Homebrew in /opt/homebrew, installed asdf, set up fish as my shell. In VSCode integrated terminal fish starts but `asdf` isn't available. Terminal in Terminal.app works. Anyone else hit this?

Tess: welcome! VSCode launches non-login shells. For fish put `set -x PATH /opt/homebrew/bin $PATH` in ~/.config/fish/config.fish and also source asdf: `source /opt/homebrew/opt/asdf/libexec/asdf.fish` (path may vary). Restart the terminal.

Sam: also add direnv hook early if you use direnv: `eval (direnv hook fish)` in config.fish. If you rely on env vars like LDFLAGS for building ruby/node, make sure they are exported in config.fish or in direnv .envrc.

Noah: thanks — added the PATH and sourced asdf.fish. Now `asdf install nodejs 18.16.0` fails with a gpg key error for the node plugin.

Tess: run the import script: `bash ~/.asdf/plugins/nodejs/bin/import-release-team-keyring`. If gpg is the system one it's usually fine; if you installed gnupg via brew confirm `which gpg` points to /opt/homebrew/bin/gpg. You might need to set GNUPGHOME to a writable directory if the script complains.

Sam: FYI on 1Password + devcontainers: forwarding host agent into containers is flaky. We prefer a container-local flow: `eval "$(op signin --sh)"` then `op item get <ssh-key> --attributes privateKey | ssh-add -`. Our dotfiles include scripts/attach-op-ssh that creates a container socket and adds the key. Ping me and I can paste it.

Noah: I'm trying to keep OP_SESSION_* alive across shells — is it safe to put `eval "$(op signin --sh)"` in config.fish?

Tess: it's ok for an interactive dev machine but not recommended for CI/devcontainer entrypoints. OP sessions expire and you don't want to leak tokens into processes. For containers we run sign-in when the dev container starts and store the session in the container user env only. For local shells, put a small helper `scripts/op-maybe-signin` that checks for a valid OP_SESSION and only runs signin when needed.

Sam: small tip: in fish the eval snippet becomes `eval (op signin --sh)` without the dollars. Also for ssh-agent, create a stable socket location like `~/.ssh/agent.sock` and set `SSH_AUTH_SOCK` to it in config.fish so different terminal tabs reuse the same agent.

Noah: got it. One last oddity: after reshimming npm global bins aren't picked up in the current shell until I open a new tab. Is there a fast way?

Tess: run `hash -r` in fish to clear the command cache. Also ensure `~/.asdf/shims` is first in PATH. If reshim wrote a new shim, the current shell may still cache old paths.

ops-bot: onboarding checklist: dev environment bootstrap pending steps: 'ssh key configured' for Noah. See https://handbook.redwood.com/onboarding.

Noah: Thanks everyone — fixed the fish config, imported gpg keys, and set up the op helper. Will follow up if anything breaks :slightly_smiling_face:
